data.name: Guillaume
data.gender_notes: Guillaume is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Germanic name Willhelm, composed of the elements wil, meaning will, and helm, meaning helmet or protection. The name Guillaume was popularized in France and became identified with the Latin term Guilielmus, meaning ‘helper of God’. In the Middle Ages, this name was frequently given to sons born to noble families, and many notable figures throughout history have borne this name.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name inspired by the Christian virtue of helping others.
data.etymology: Guillaume belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “William, helper of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Guillaume total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: גיום
in_hebrew.long_meaning: גיום הוא שם שמקורו בשם העברי 'יעקב', שפירושו 'הוא יחזיק בעקבו' או 'אל יעזור'. השם עבר דרך השפה היוונית והלטינית והפך לשם נפוץ בקרב הנוצרים. מבחינה רוחנית, השם גיום מייצג את האמונה באלוהים כמושיע ובעוזרו הנאמן.

in_greek.name: Γουλιέλμος
in_greek.meaning: Θεός θέλει, ο Θεός είναι σωτήρας
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Γουλιέλμος προέρχεται από το εβραϊκό όνομα 'Γιάακωβ', που σημαίνει 'αυτόν θα κρατήσει με την πτέρνα' ή 'Θεός θέλει'. Το όνομα πέρασε από την ελληνική και λατινική γλώσσα και έγινε δημοφιλές μεταξύ των Χριστιανών. Πνευματικά, το όνομα Γουλιέλμος αντιπροσωπεύει την πίστη στον Θεό ως Σωτήρα και στον πιστό του βοηθό.

in_latin.name: Guillaume
in_latin.long_meaning: Guillaume orignatur ex nomine hebraeo 'Iacob', quod significat 'ipse tenebit per calcaneum' vel 'Deus vult'. Nomen per linguam graecam et latinam transiit et inter Christianos populare factum est. Spiritualiter, nomen Guillaume fidem in Deum ut Salvatorem et adiutorem fidelum repraesentat.

in_english.name: Guillaume
in_english.long_meaning: The name Guillaume originates from the Hebrew 'Ya'aqov', meaning 'he will supplant' or 'God will protect'. It passed through Greek and Latin, becoming a popular Christian name. Spiritually, Guillaume represents faith in God as protector and savior. Historically, it was popularized by several saints and nobles, symbolizing devotion and strength.

data.cultural_impact: The name Guillaume has been historically associated with French nobility and spiritual devotion due to its meaning as ‘helper of God’. Many famous French kings, knights, and saints have borne this name, turning it into a symbol of French culture, power, and holiness.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Guillaume carries a deep spiritual meaning rooted in its origin as a name of Germanic origin, meaning ‘helper of God’. This name reflects a strong connection to divine protection, devotion, and faith, making it a powerful and inspiring choice for those seeking a strong spiritual foundation in their lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Guillaume, meaning "will power of God" in French, symbolizes the strength and determination derived from divine guidance. It is a reminder of God's omnipotence in shaping one's will and character.
